beginner.title: Get started with SessionLab
beginner.outcome: You can: set up SessionLab, find your way around and finish a first small task
beginner.practice: Complete the official getting-started guide, then one small real task from your work

beginner.title: Join and communicate
beginner.outcome: You can: communicate clearly in SessionLab
beginner.practice: Post an update and share a file with your team

beginner.title: Stay focused
beginner.outcome: You can: manage notifications and find things
beginner.practice: Set notifications so only what matters reaches you

intermediate.title: Organise work
intermediate.outcome: You can: structure work for a team
intermediate.practice: Set up a space for a real project

intermediate.title: Run meetings and workshops
intermediate.outcome: You can: use SessionLab before, during and after meetings
intermediate.practice: Run one meeting entirely through SessionLab

intermediate.title: Signature skills in SessionLab
intermediate.outcome: You can: use the features that make SessionLab distinctive
intermediate.practice: Use each of these features once on a real piece of work

expert.title: Advanced SessionLab
expert.outcome: You can: use SessionLab's advanced capabilities with confidence
expert.practice: Complete a project that needs at least two of these advanced capabilities

expert.title: Govern the workspace
expert.outcome: You can: keep the workspace secure and tidy
expert.practice: Review who has access and archive stale spaces

expert.title: Integrate SessionLab into your workflow
expert.outcome: You can: connect SessionLab with the other tools you use
expert.practice: Connect SessionLab to one other tool you use and remove one manual step

expert.title: Lead and teach others
expert.outcome: You can: set standards and teach others to use SessionLab well
expert.practice: Write a one-page "how we use SessionLab" guide and teach it to one person

expert_validation.note: Generated from the archetype template plus tool-specific signature skills; to be reviewed by a practitioner.
